This aligns with the known complications of long-standing diabetes, which can lead to neuropathy. Duloxetine is recognized as a first-line treatment for diabetic neuropathic pain, as it is effective in managing such symptoms. Other options like ibuprofen and oxycodone are not considered first-line treatments for neuropathic pain; ibuprofen is primarily an anti-inflammatory and analgesic, while oxycodone is an opioid used for severe pain but not specifically indicated for neuropathic pain. Therefore, the most appropriate first-line treatment for this patient's condition is Duloxetine.
